items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Drives motorized equipment: Yes
4 7 years of experience

Evaluates transcripts and international records for eligibility. Responsible for all phases of admission eligibility evaluation of both freshman and transfer students based on self-reported information, official transcripts, and other pertinent documents. (15% time)
Plans visits to schools, schedules and makes presentations, interviews, and follow-up visits. (10% time)
Assesses academic preparedness of traditional, special-program, and international applicants. (10% time)
Will conduct research of foreign educational systems as needed and analyzes academic records from foreign secondary and tertiary institutions (including study abroad records). (10% time)
Identifies potential students and provides general information about higher education and about the UC specifically. (5% time)
Provides in-depth information on admissions requirements, prerequisite courses, school / college programs and curricula, specific financial aid criteria, and career opportunities. (5% time)

Assesses applicants for motivation, initiative, leadership potential, work / life experience, extracurricular activities, socioeconomic status, disability, and educational /personal hardship. (5% time)
Serves as liaison between students, parents, colleges / universities, community agencies, and UC college / school / department. (5% time)

Uses extensive knowledge of college / school / department requirements and applicant pool, to assess the applicants' overall record and experience for final admissions determination and recommendation. (5% time)
Screens applicants for school / college / department faculty. (5% time)
Uses professional judgment when reviewing complex applications for admission. (5% time)
Produces special and annual reports, and program evaluations. (5% time)
Performs course-by-course evaluations for transfer credits. (5% time)
Plans, manages and implements events to enhance recruitment and yield, diversity initiative events, mentoring programs, electronic communications, and similar activities. (5% time)
Assesses effectiveness in attracting quality students to UC. (5% time)
Valid Drivers License
Read/Comprehend: Constantly
Write: Constantly
Perform Calculations: Frequently
Communicate Orally: Constantly
Reason & Analyze: Constantly
Sit: Frequently

Skill in organizing and setting priorities that accurately reflect the importance of the job responsibilities.

Thorough and comprehensive knowledge of academic programs, including curricula, admissions requirements, and financial aid programs, at colleges /universities and specifically at UC, and / or specific colleges and schools.
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative relationships with schools, universities, community organizations, and other institutions.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.
Thorough knowledge and experience working with a diverse student population.
Skill in listening, anticipating, and responding to the needs of customers to achieve excellent customer service measured by outcomes rather than activities.
Ability to interpret policies and procedures to prospective students and the public.
Ability to effectively manage a large volume of undergraduate admissions applications and multiple programs in a timely manner while maintaining confidentialityat all times.
Ability to develop recruitment programs, and design effective materials.
Ability to analyze, interpret, and evaluate statistical data and policy related to undergraduate admissions metrics.
